verdict.summary: Round 3 resolves the prior major finding. The design record now restores Alt-A to an explicitly undecided, measure-first state; labels the off-tree probes unreviewable; reproduces none of their results; and makes the future verdict contingent on landing reviewable methodology plus a regression-gated `_comment_sq_uii0` snapshot. The remaining discussion is carefully framed as hypotheses and existing in-tree precedent rather than empirical findings. The changed passages are internally consistent and do not make an unsupported ZK soundness, privacy, or performance claim.
